namespace SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsHingeExpectations

def hinge (value threshold : ℝ) : ℝ := max (value - threshold) 0
def hingeQuotient (value center threshold : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (hinge value threshold - hinge value center) / (threshold - center)

theorem actual_hinge_difference_quotients_are_uniformly_bounded_by_one
    (value center threshold : ℝ) : |hingeQuotient value center threshold| ≤ 1 := by
  have hb := abs_max_sub_max_le_max (value - threshold) 0 (value - center) 0
  have heq : (value - threshold) - (value - center) = -(threshold - center) := by ring
  simp only [sub_zero, abs_zero] at hb
  rw [heq, abs_neg, max_eq_left (abs_nonneg (threshold - center))] at hb
  change |hinge value threshold - hinge value center| ≤ |threshold - center| at hb
  unfold hingeQuotient
  rw [abs_div]
  by_cases he : threshold = center
  · simp [he]
  · exact (div_le_one (abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr he))).mpr hb

theorem actual_every_point_right_hinge_quotient_limit_retains_the_strict_tail
    (value center : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun threshold => hingeQuotient value center threshold) (𝓝[>] center)
      (𝓝 (if center < value then (-1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
  by_cases h : center < value
  · simp only [ite_eq_left h]
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    have hi0 : ∀ᶠ threshold in 𝓝 center, threshold < value := Iio_mem_nhds h
    have hi : ∀ᶠ threshold in 𝓝[>] center, threshold < value :=
      hi0.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    filter_upwards [hi, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with threshold ht hn
    change center < threshold at hn
    unfold hingeQuotient hinge
    rw [max_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_left (by linarith)]
    field_simp [(sub_pos.mpr hn).ne']
    ring
  · simp only [ite_eq_right h]
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with threshold hn
    change center < threshold at hn
    have hc : value ≤ center := le_of_not_gt h
    simp [hingeQuotient, hinge, max_eq_right (by linarith : value - threshold ≤ 0),
      max_eq_right (by linarith : value - center ≤ 0)]

theorem actual_every_point_left_hinge_quotient_limit_retains_the_nonstrict_tail
    (value center : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun threshold => hingeQuotient value center threshold) (𝓝[<] center)
      (𝓝 (if center ≤ value then (-1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
  by_cases h : center ≤ value
  · simp only [ite_eq_left h]
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with threshold hn
    change threshold < center at hn
    unfold hingeQuotient hinge
    rw [max_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_left (by linarith)]
    field_simp [sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_lt hn)]
    ring
  · simp only [ite_eq_right h]
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    have hv : value < center := lt_of_not_ge h
    have hi0 : ∀ᶠ threshold in 𝓝 center, value < threshold := Ioi_mem_nhds hv
    have hi : ∀ᶠ threshold in 𝓝[<] center, value < threshold :=
      hi0.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    filter_upwards [hi] with threshold ht
    simp [hingeQuotient, hinge, max_eq_right (by linarith : value - threshold ≤ 0),
      max_eq_right (by linarith : value - center ≤ 0)]

theorem actual_integrable_random_loss_has_integrable_hinge_at_every_threshold
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω → ℝ) (h : Integrable loss P) (threshold : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun omega => hinge (loss omega) threshold) P := by
  exact (h.sub (integrable_const threshold)).sup (integrable_const 0)

theorem actual_bounded_convergence_moves_both_one_sided_hinge_quotients_through_expectation
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω → ℝ) (hm : Measurable loss) (hi : Integrable loss P) (center : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun threshold =>
      ((∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) threshold ∂P) -
        (∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) center ∂P)) / (threshold - center))
      (𝓝[>] center) (𝓝 (-P.real {omega | center < loss omega})) ∧
    Tendsto (fun threshold =>
      ((∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) threshold ∂P) -
        (∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) center ∂P)) / (threshold - center))
      (𝓝[<] center) (𝓝 (-P.real {omega | center ≤ loss omega})) := by
  have hmeas (threshold : ℝ) :
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun omega => hingeQuotient (loss omega) center threshold) P := by
    unfold hingeQuotient hinge
    exact ((((hm.sub measurable_const).max measurable_const).sub
      ((hm.sub measurable_const).max measurable_const)).div_const _).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hbound (threshold : ℝ) : ∀ᵐ omega ∂P,
      ‖hingeQuotient (loss omega) center threshold‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ) :=
    Eventually.of_forall (fun omega => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        actual_hinge_difference_quotients_are_uniformly_bounded_by_one (loss omega) center threshold)
  have hright := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ))
    (Eventually.of_forall hmeas) (Eventually.of_forall hbound) (integrable_const 1)
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun omega =>
      actual_every_point_right_hinge_quotient_limit_retains_the_strict_tail (loss omega) center))
  have hleft := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ))
    (Eventually.of_forall hmeas) (Eventually.of_forall hbound) (integrable_const 1)
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun omega =>
      actual_every_point_left_hinge_quotient_limit_retains_the_nonstrict_tail (loss omega) center))
  have hformula (threshold : ℝ) :
      (∫ omega, hingeQuotient (loss omega) center threshold ∂P) =
      ((∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) threshold ∂P) -
        (∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) center ∂P)) / (threshold - center) := by
    unfold hingeQuotient
    rw [integral_div, integral_sub
      (actual_integrable_random_loss_has_integrable_hinge_at_every_threshold loss hi threshold)
      (actual_integrable_random_loss_has_integrable_hinge_at_every_threshold loss hi center)]
  have hrightIntegral :
      (∫ omega, (if center < loss omega then (-1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂P) =
        -P.real {omega | center < loss omega} := by
    have hs : MeasurableSet {omega | center < loss omega} := measurableSet_lt measurable_const hm
    calc
      _ = (∫ omega, ({omega | center < loss omega}).indicator
          (fun _ : Ω => (-1 : ℝ)) omega ∂P) := by rfl
      _ = _ := by simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_neg_one] using integral_indicator_const (-1 : ℝ) hs
  have hleftIntegral :
      (∫ omega, (if center ≤ loss omega then (-1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂P) =
        -P.real {omega | center ≤ loss omega} := by
    have hs : MeasurableSet {omega | center ≤ loss omega} := measurableSet_le measurable_const hm
    calc
      _ = (∫ omega, ({omega | center ≤ loss omega}).indicator
          (fun _ : Ω => (-1 : ℝ)) omega ∂P) := by rfl
      _ = _ := by simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_neg_one] using integral_indicator_const (-1 : ℝ) hs
  simpa only [hformula, hrightIntegral, hleftIntegral] using And.intro hright hleft

end SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsHingeExpectations

def admissibleSelectors {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) (mass : ℝ) : Set (Ω→ℝ) :=
  {selector | Measurable selector ∧ (∀omega,selector omega∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
    (∫omega,selector omega ∂P)=mass}

def actualTailMean {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
    (loss selector : Ω→ℝ) (mass : ℝ) : ℝ := (∫omega,loss omega*selector omega ∂P)/mass

def actualWorstTailMean {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
    (loss : Ω→ℝ) (mass : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup ((fun selector=>actualTailMean P loss selector mass) '' admissibleSelectors P mass)

    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]

    exact (hb omega).2
  · apply hi.mono (hi.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hm.aestronglyMeasurable)
    filter_upwards [] with omega

    simp only [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (hb omega).1]

    (selector : Ω→ℝ) (hs : selector∈admissibleSelectors P (1-alpha))

open Set
namespace SafeLearning.CompleteModulesLandscapeWindClassification26

/-- An admissible gust obeys the source's pointwise norm-two bound as well as any
model-specific admissibility requirements. Time and wind dimensions are arbitrary. -/
def sourceAdmissibleGusts {Time Wind : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Wind]
    (allowed : Set (Time → Wind)) : Set (Time → Wind) :=
  {gust | gust ∈ allowed ∧ ∀ t, ‖gust t‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ)}

/-- The controller is fixed before the gust is quantified. The run family can
represent continuous trajectories, discrete trajectories or history-based policies. -/
def sourceRobustSafety {Time Wind State Controller : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Wind]
    (run : State → Controller → (Time → Wind) → Time → State)
    (controller : Controller) (safe : Set State) (allowed : Set (Time → Wind)) : Prop :=
  ∀ initial ∈ safe, ∀ gust ∈ sourceAdmissibleGusts allowed,
    ∀ t, run initial controller gust t ∈ safe

/-- Forward invariance for each allowed gust is a hard all-time constraint,
with the same controller and every covered initial state throughout. -/
theorem actual_source_wind_guarantee_is_same_controller_robust_forward_invariance
    {Time Wind State Controller : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Wind]
    (run : State → Controller → (Time → Wind) → Time → State)
    (controller : Controller) (safe : Set State) (allowed : Set (Time → Wind)) :
    sourceRobustSafety run controller safe allowed ↔
      ∀ gust, gust ∈ allowed → (∀ t, ‖gust t‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ)) →
        ∀ initial ∈ safe, ∀ t, run initial controller gust t ∈ safe := by
  constructor
  · intro h gust ha hb initial hi t
    exact h initial hi gust ⟨ha, hb⟩ t
  · intro h initial hi gust hg t
    exact h gust hg.1 hg.2 initial hi t

/-- A deterministic robust certificate directly protects each admissible run.
No probability distribution, average or new controller choice is needed. -/
theorem actual_robust_certificate_protects_each_admissible_initial_gust_and_time
    {Time Wind State Controller : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Wind]
    (run : State → Controller → (Time → Wind) → Time → State)
    (controller : Controller) (safe : Set State) (allowed : Set (Time → Wind))
    (certificate : sourceRobustSafety run controller safe allowed)
    (initial : State) (hi : initial ∈ safe) (gust : Time → Wind)
    (ha : gust ∈ allowed) (hb : ∀ t, ‖gust t‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ)) (t : Time) :
    run initial controller gust t ∈ safe :=
  certificate initial hi gust ⟨ha, hb⟩ t

/-- Allowing a different controller after seeing each gust is a weaker condition. -/
theorem actual_fixed_controller_robust_safety_implies_gustwise_controller_existence
    {Time Wind State Controller : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Wind]
    (run : State → Controller → (Time → Wind) → Time → State)
    (safe : Set State) (allowed : Set (Time → Wind))
    (h : ∃ controller, sourceRobustSafety run controller safe allowed) :
    ∀ gust ∈ sourceAdmissibleGusts allowed,
      ∃ controller, ∀ initial ∈ safe, ∀ t, run initial controller gust t ∈ safe := by
  obtain ⟨controller, hc⟩ := h
  intro gust hg
  exact ⟨controller, fun initial hi t => hc initial hi gust hg t⟩

/-- The quantifier order matters even for constant one-time gusts: a controller
chosen after observing the gust can cancel it, but a single scalar input cannot
cancel both allowed gusts +2 and -2. This is a mathematical counterexample,
not a model of the source quadrotor. -/
theorem actual_gustwise_recovery_does_not_supply_one_robust_controller :
    (∀ gust : ℝ, |gust| ≤ 2 → ∃ controller : ℝ, controller + gust = 0) ∧
      ¬∃ controller : ℝ, ∀ gust : ℝ, |gust| ≤ 2 → controller + gust = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro gust _
    exact ⟨-gust, by ring⟩
  · rintro ⟨controller, hc⟩
    have hp := hc 2 (by norm_num)
    have hm := hc (-2) (by norm_num)
    linarith

end SafeLearning.CompleteModulesLandscapeWindClassification26

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedCVaRQuantileExistence26

/-- Every real probability law, including laws with atoms and gaps, has an
attained quantile whose lower and upper CDF values bracket each interior level. -/
theorem actual_arbitrary_real_probability_has_an_attained_fractional_tail_threshold
    (P : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (alpha : ℝ)
    (ha0 : 0 < alpha) (ha1 : alpha < 1) :
    ∃ threshold : ℝ,
      Function.leftLim (cdf P) threshold ≤ alpha ∧ alpha ≤ cdf P threshold := by
  let upper : Set ℝ := {x | alpha ≤ cdf P x}
  obtain ⟨above, habove⟩ := ((tendsto_cdf_atTop P).eventually (eventually_gt_nhds ha1)).exists
  obtain ⟨below, hbelow⟩ := ((tendsto_cdf_atBot P).eventually (eventually_lt_nhds ha0)).exists
  have hnonempty : upper.Nonempty := ⟨above, habove.le⟩
  have hbounded : BddBelow upper := by
    refine ⟨below, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    have horder : x ≤ below := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge h)
    have hcdf := (monotone_cdf P) horder
    exact (not_le_of_gt hbelow) ((show alpha ≤ cdf P x from hx).trans hcdf)
  let threshold : ℝ := sInf upper
  have haboveroot : ∀ x : Ioi threshold, alpha ≤ cdf P x := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt hnonempty x.property
    exact (show alpha ≤ cdf P y from hy).trans ((monotone_cdf P) hyx.le)
  have hroot : alpha ≤ cdf P threshold := by
    letI : Nonempty (Ioi threshold) := ⟨⟨threshold + 1, by simp⟩⟩
    rw [← (cdf P).iInf_Ioi_eq threshold]
    exact le_ciInf haboveroot
  have hbelowroot : ∀ x : ℝ, x < threshold → cdf P x < alpha := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    have hmember : x ∈ upper := le_of_not_gt h
    exact (not_le_of_gt hx) (csInf_le hbounded hmember)
  have hleft : Function.leftLim (cdf P) threshold ≤ alpha := by
    rw [(monotone_cdf P).leftLim_eq_sSup]
    apply csSup_le
    · exact ⟨cdf P (threshold - 1), ⟨threshold - 1, by simp, rfl⟩⟩
    · rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (hbelowroot x hx).le
  exact ⟨threshold, hleft, hroot⟩

end SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedCVaRQuantileExistence26

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedCVaRFractionalSelector26
open CompleteAppliedFractionalTailDual CompleteFoundationsCVaRQuotients
open CompleteFoundationsHingeExpectations CompleteAppliedCVaRQuantileExistence26

/-- The fractional selector includes every strict-tail loss, exactly the necessary
fraction of an atom at its threshold, and none of the lower losses. -/
def fractionalSelector {Ω : Type*} (loss : Ω→ℝ) (q r : ℝ) : Ω→ℝ :=
  fun w=>if q<loss w then 1 else if loss w=q then r else 0

/-- A quantile of the genuine loss law brackets the desired tail mass. -/
theorem actual_arbitrary_loss_has_a_tail_mass_bracketing_threshold
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω→ℝ) (hm : Measurable loss) (alpha : ℝ) (ha0 : 0<alpha) (ha1 : alpha<1) :
    ∃q : ℝ,P.real {w | q<loss w}≤1-alpha ∧
      1-alpha≤P.real {w | q<loss w}+P.real {w | loss w=q} := by
  let law:=P.map loss
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hm.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  obtain ⟨q,hleft,hupper⟩ :=
    actual_arbitrary_real_probability_has_an_attained_fractional_tail_threshold law alpha ha0 ha1
  have htail : law.real (Ioi q)=1-cdf law q := by
    rw [show Ioi q=(Iic q)ᶜ by ext x;simp,
      probReal_compl_eq_one_sub measurableSet_Iic,←cdf_eq_real law q]
  have hpoint : law.real {q}=cdf law q-Function.leftLim (cdf law) q := by
    have hraw : law {q}=ENNReal.ofReal (cdf law q-Function.leftLim (cdf law) q) := by
      calc
        law {q}=(cdf law).measure {q} := by rw [measure_cdf law]
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (cdf law q-Function.leftLim (cdf law) q) :=
          StieltjesFunction.measure_singleton (cdf law) q
    rw [measureReal_def,hraw]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sub_nonneg.mpr ((monotone_cdf law).leftLim_le le_rfl))
  have ht : law.real (Ioi q)=P.real {w | q<loss w} := by
    simpa only [measureReal_def,Set.preimage,Set.mem_Ioi] using
      congrArg ENNReal.toReal (Measure.map_apply (μ:=P) hm (measurableSet_Ioi (a:=q)))
  have hb : law.real {q}=P.real {w | loss w=q} := by

theorem actual_boundary_fraction_is_in_unit_interval_and_mass_matched
    (mass above boundary : ℝ) (hb : 0≤boundary)
    (hu : above≤ mass) (hut : mass≤above+boundary) :
    (mass-above)/boundary∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ∧
      above+((mass-above)/boundary)*boundary=mass := by
  have hnum : 0≤ mass-above := sub_nonneg.mpr hu

/-- Measurability and actual pointwise range hold for the constructed selector. -/
theorem actual_fractional_threshold_selector_measurable_and_bounded
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (loss : Ω→ℝ) (hm : Measurable loss)
    (q r : ℝ) (hr : r∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    Measurable (fractionalSelector loss q r) ∧
      (∀w,fractionalSelector loss q r w∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
      (∀w,q<loss w→fractionalSelector loss q r w=1) ∧
      (∀w,loss w<q→fractionalSelector loss q r w=0) := by
  have ha : MeasurableSet {w | q<loss w} := measurableSet_lt measurable_const hm
  have he : MeasurableSet {w | loss w=q} := measurableSet_eq_fun hm measurable_const
  refine ⟨measurable_const.ite ha (measurable_const.ite he measurable_const),?_,?_,?_⟩

    by_cases hqa : q<loss w

    · by_cases hqe : loss w=q
      · simpa [fractionalSelector,hqa,hqe] using hr
      · simp [fractionalSelector,hqa,hqe]
  · intro w hw;simp [fractionalSelector,hw]
  · intro w hw
    have hqa : ¬q<loss w := not_lt_of_ge hw.le
    have hqe : loss w≠q := ne_of_lt hw
    simp [fractionalSelector,hqa,hqe]

/-- The selector's integral is computed from the actual strict-tail and atom masses. -/
theorem actual_fractional_selector_integral_is_above_mass_plus_fractional_atom
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω→ℝ) (hm : Measurable loss) (q r : ℝ) :
    (∫w,fractionalSelector loss q r w ∂P)=
      P.real {w | q<loss w}+r*P.real {w | loss w=q} := by
  have ha : MeasurableSet {w | q<loss w} := measurableSet_lt measurable_const hm
  have he : MeasurableSet {w | loss w=q} := measurableSet_eq_fun hm measurable_const
  have hfun : fractionalSelector loss q r=
      fun w=>({w | q<loss w}.indicator (fun _=>(1:ℝ)) w)+
        ({w | loss w=q}.indicator (fun _=>r) w) := by
    funext w
    by_cases hqa : q<loss w
    · have hqe : loss w≠q := ne_of_gt hqa
      simp [fractionalSelector,hqa,hqe]
    · by_cases hqe : loss w=q
      · simp [fractionalSelector,hqa,hqe]
      · simp [fractionalSelector,hqa,hqe]
  rw [hfun,integral_add ((integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator ha)
    ((integrable_const r).indicator he),integral_indicator_const (1:ℝ) ha,integral_indicator_const r he]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul,one_mul]
  ring

including atomic distributions and the no-atom zero-boundary case. -/
theorem actual_arbitrary_measurable_loss_has_a_constructed_fractional_tail_selector
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω→ℝ) (hm : Measurable loss) (alpha : ℝ) (ha0 : 0<alpha) (ha1 : alpha<1) :
    ∃q : ℝ,let r:=(1-alpha-P.real {w | q<loss w})/P.real {w | loss w=q}

      (∀w,q<loss w→fractionalSelector loss q r w=1) ∧
      (∀w,loss w<q→fractionalSelector loss q r w=0) := by
  obtain ⟨q,hq0,hq1⟩:=actual_arbitrary_loss_has_a_tail_mass_bracketing_threshold
    P loss hm alpha ha0 ha1
  let r:=(1-alpha-P.real {w | q<loss w})/P.real {w | loss w=q}
  have hr:=actual_boundary_fraction_is_in_unit_interval_and_mass_matched
    (1-alpha) (P.real {w | q<loss w}) (P.real {w | loss w=q})
    measureReal_nonneg hq0 hq1
  have hs:=actual_fractional_threshold_selector_measurable_and_bounded loss hm q r hr.1
  refine ⟨q,⟨hs.1,hs.2.1,?_⟩,hs.2.2.1,hs.2.2.2⟩
  rw [actual_fractional_selector_integral_is_above_mass_plus_fractional_atom P loss hm q r]
  simpa only [mul_comm,r] using hr.2

/-- Every integrable real loss has both a genuine greatest fractional tail and an
attained global minimum of the RU objective, with equal values. -/
theorem actual_arbitrary_integrable_loss_has_greatest_tail_and_attained_least_RU
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω→ℝ) (hm : Measurable loss) (hi : Integrable loss P)
    (alpha : ℝ) (ha0 : 0<alpha) (ha1 : alpha<1) :
    ∃q : ℝ,∃selector : Ω→ℝ,
      selector∈admissibleSelectors P (1-alpha) ∧
      IsGreatest ((fun other=>actualTailMean P loss other (1-alpha)) '' admissibleSelectors P (1-alpha))
        (actualTailMean P loss selector (1-alpha)) ∧
      IsLeast (Set.range (actualRUObjective P loss alpha)) (actualRUObjective P loss alpha q) ∧
      actualWorstTailMean P loss (1-alpha)=actualRUObjective P loss alpha q := by
  obtain ⟨q,hs,habove,hbelow⟩:=actual_arbitrary_measurable_loss_has_a_constructed_fractional_tail_selector
    P loss hm alpha ha0 ha1
  let selector:=fractionalSelector loss q
    ((1-alpha-P.real {w | q<loss w})/P.real {w | loss w=q})
  have ho:=actual_mass_matched_threshold_selector_is_greatest_tail_and_least_RU_objective
    loss hi alpha q ha1 selector hs habove hbelow
  exact ⟨q,selector,hs,ho⟩

/-- The source's strict worst-five-percent criterion is equivalent to the attained
RU certificate for arbitrary integrable laws, not only finite distributions. -/
theorem actual_arbitrary_loss_worst_five_percent_below_ten_iff_RU_certificate
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω→ℝ) (hm : Measurable loss) (hi : Integrable loss P) :
    actualWorstTailMean P loss (1/20)<10 ↔
      ∃q : ℝ,q+20*(∫w,hinge (loss w) q ∂P)<10 := by
  obtain ⟨q,selector,hs,hgreatest,hleast,heq⟩:=
    actual_arbitrary_integrable_loss_has_greatest_tail_and_attained_least_RU
      P loss hm hi (19/20) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hmass : (1-(19/20):ℝ)=1/20 := by norm_num
  have hru : ∀t,actualRUObjective P loss (19/20) t=
      t+20*(∫w,hinge (loss w) t ∂P) := by
    intro t;unfold actualRUObjective;norm_num
  rw [hmass] at heq
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨q,by rw [←hru,←heq];exact h⟩
  · rintro ⟨t,ht⟩
    rw [heq]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hleast.2 ⟨t,rfl⟩) (by rw [hru];exact ht)

Definition — (d) Risk-sensitive constraints: CVaR
      For an integrable cost $Z$ ($\mathbb E|Z|<\infty$; large is bad) and $\alpha\in(0,1)$, the conditional value-at-risk in the Rockafellar–Uryasev form used by Chow, Ghavamzadeh, Janson & Pavone, JMLR 2018 is
      $$\operatorname{CVaR}_\alpha(Z)=\min_{\nu\in\mathbb R}\Big\{\nu+\frac{1}{1-\alpha}\,\mathbb E\big[(Z-\nu)^+\big]\Big\},$$
      the average of the worst $(1-\alpha)$-fraction of outcomes: $\alpha\to1$ is the tail, $\alpha\to0$ recovers $\mathbb E[Z]$. A risk constraint reads $\operatorname{CVaR}_\alpha(\sum_t c_t)\le d$. Example: the 5% worst episodes must average fewer than $d$ contacts. It controls frequency and magnitude of bad episodes, which neither (b) nor (c) does alone (first walkthrough below, Step 5).

Definition — (c) Expected-cost constraints: the CMDP
A constrained MDP (Primer E) adds cost functions $c_i$ and budgets $d_i$ to an MDP and restricts the policy class (Altman, 1999; notation of Achiam et al., ICML 2017; $\operatorname{arg\,max}$: Primer B):
$$\pi^\star=\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{\pi}\ J(\pi)\quad\text{s.t.}\quad J_{c_i}(\pi)=\mathbb E_{\tau\sim\pi}\Big[\sum_{t=0}^{\infty}\gamma^t c_i(s_t,a_t,s_{t+1})\Big]\le d_i .$$
The constraint is an expectation over episodes of a discounted sum; single episodes may violate arbitrarily. Altman minimises a cost with discount $\alpha$ and initial law $\beta$; Paternain et al., NeurIPS 2019 maximise with reward-type constraints $V_i(\pi)\ge c_i$. We use the reward-max, cost-$\le d$ form everywhere. Example: Safety Gym's budget $d=25$: expected (undiscounted) cost per 1000-step episode, one unit for every step spent in a hazard or other unsafe contact (Ray, Achiam & Amodei, 2019).

Here $J(\pi)=\mathbb E_{\tau\sim\pi}[\sum_{t\ge0}\gamma^t r_t]$ with $0\le\gamma\lt1$, and $\tau\sim\pi$ means that the trajectory $\tau=(s_0,a_0,s_1,\dots)$ is generated by a fixed initial-state distribution, the policy and the transition law. $J_{c_i}$ is an expected discounted sum; papers that use the normalized $(1-\gamma)J_{c_i}$ (a weighted average, since the weights $(1-\gamma)\gamma^t$ sum to 1) scale their budgets by the same factor. Rewards and costs are assumed bounded, so all these expectations are finite.

Definition — (d) Risk-sensitive constraints: CVaR
For an integrable cost $Z$ ($\mathbb E|Z|<\infty$; large is bad) and $\alpha\in(0,1)$, the conditional value-at-risk in the Rockafellar–Uryasev form used by Chow, Ghavamzadeh, Janson & Pavone, JMLR 2018 is
$$\operatorname{CVaR}_\alpha(Z)=\min_{\nu\in\mathbb R}\Big\{\nu+\frac{1}{1-\alpha}\,\mathbb E\big[(Z-\nu)^+\big]\Big\},$$
the average of the worst $(1-\alpha)$-fraction of outcomes: $\alpha\to1$ is the tail, $\alpha\to0$ recovers $\mathbb E[Z]$. A risk constraint reads $\operatorname{CVaR}_\alpha(\sum_t c_t)\le d$. Example: the 5% worst episodes must average fewer than $d$ contacts. It controls frequency and magnitude of bad episodes, which neither (b) nor (c) does alone (first walkthrough below, Step 5).
Caveat — two conventions for $\alpha$
Chow et al. (and this section) use $\alpha$ as the confidence level: the worst $1-\alpha$ fraction is averaged and $\alpha\to1$ is risk-averse. Their prose says "worst-case $\alpha$-fraction" while their formula, with $1/(1-\alpha)$, averages the worst $(1-\alpha)$-fraction; the formula is authoritative. WCSAC-type deep RL papers use $\alpha$ for the tail fraction, so there $\alpha\to0$ is risk-averse. Check the formula, not the words.
Definition — (e) Stability and regions of attraction
An equilibrium $x^\ast$ is asymptotically stable if it is Lyapunov stable (trajectories that start close to $x^\ast$ stay close) and attractive (Primer D); its region of attraction $\mathcal R$ is the set of initial states whose trajectories converge to $x^\ast$. A Lyapunov function (continuous, positive definite about $x^\ast$) certifies a subset: if the closed-loop map $F(x)=f(x,\pi(x))$ is continuous with $F(x^\ast)=x^\ast$ and $V(F(x))-V(x)\lt0$ for all $x\ne x^\ast$ in a compact sublevel set $\mathcal V(c)=\{x:V(x)\le c\}$ (compact means closed and bounded in $\mathbb R^n$, Primer 0), then $\mathcal V(c)$ is forward invariant and $\mathcal V(c)\subseteq\mathcal R$ (continuity of $F$ is what makes the limit set, the points that $x_t$ approaches along some sequence of times $t_k\to\infty$, invariant; without it $V$ can decrease forever without reaching $x^\ast$). Berkenkamp et al., NeurIPS 2017 define the safety constraint as never leaving the region of attraction and certify it through a Lyapunov sublevel set: the pendulum may move but never falls. Deterministic given a model; with a GP model the decrease condition is checked on an upper confidence bound and holds with probability $1-\delta$ (Module 11).

Definition — Quantile function, VaR and CVaR (cost convention)
      For a cost $Z$ (large is bad) with CDF $F$, the quantile function (generalised inverse) $F^{-1}(u)=\inf\{z:\ F(z)\ge u\}$, $u\in(0,1)$, handles flat pieces and jumps of $F$. For a confidence level $\alpha\in(0,1)$,
      $$\operatorname{VaR}_\alpha(Z)=F^{-1}(\alpha),\qquad \operatorname{CVaR}_\alpha(Z)=\frac1{1-\alpha}\int_\alpha^1\operatorname{VaR}_u(Z)\,du ,$$
      the average of the worst $(1-\alpha)$-fraction of outcomes. If $U\sim\mathcal U(0,1)$, then $F^{-1}(U)$ has the law of $Z$ (inverse-transform sampling), so $\mathbb E[Z]=\int_0^1F^{-1}(u)\,du$: $\operatorname{CVaR}_\alpha(Z)\to\mathbb E[Z]$ as $\alpha\to0$, and $\operatorname{CVaR}_\alpha(Z)\to\operatorname{ess\,sup}Z$ as $\alpha\to1$.

/-- Every real probability law, including laws with atoms and gaps, has an
attained quantile whose lower and upper CDF values bracket each interior level. -/
theorem actual_arbitrary_real_probability_has_an_attained_fractional_tail_threshold
    (P : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (alpha : ℝ)
    (ha0 : 0 < alpha) (ha1 : alpha < 1) :
    ∃ threshold : ℝ,
      Function.leftLim (cdf P) threshold ≤ alpha ∧ alpha ≤ cdf P threshold := by
  let upper : Set ℝ := {x | alpha ≤ cdf P x}
  obtain ⟨above, habove⟩ := ((tendsto_cdf_atTop P).eventually (eventually_gt_nhds ha1)).exists
  obtain ⟨below, hbelow⟩ := ((tendsto_cdf_atBot P).eventually (eventually_lt_nhds ha0)).exists
  have hnonempty : upper.Nonempty := ⟨above, habove.le⟩
  have hbounded : BddBelow upper := by
    refine ⟨below, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    have horder : x ≤ below := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge h)
    have hcdf := (monotone_cdf P) horder
    exact (not_le_of_gt hbelow) ((show alpha ≤ cdf P x from hx).trans hcdf)
  let threshold : ℝ := sInf upper
  have haboveroot : ∀ x : Ioi threshold, alpha ≤ cdf P x := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt hnonempty x.property
    exact (show alpha ≤ cdf P y from hy).trans ((monotone_cdf P) hyx.le)
  have hroot : alpha ≤ cdf P threshold := by
    letI : Nonempty (Ioi threshold) := ⟨⟨threshold + 1, by simp⟩⟩
    rw [← (cdf P).iInf_Ioi_eq threshold]
    exact le_ciInf haboveroot
  have hbelowroot : ∀ x : ℝ, x < threshold → cdf P x < alpha := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    have hmember : x ∈ upper := le_of_not_gt h
    exact (not_le_of_gt hx) (csInf_le hbounded hmember)
  have hleft : Function.leftLim (cdf P) threshold ≤ alpha := by
    rw [(monotone_cdf P).leftLim_eq_sSup]
    apply csSup_le
    · exact ⟨cdf P (threshold - 1), ⟨threshold - 1, by simp, rfl⟩⟩
    · rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (hbelowroot x hx).le
  exact ⟨threshold, hleft, hroot⟩

end SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedCVaRQuantileExistence26

def admissibleSelectors {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) (mass : ℝ) : Set (Ω→ℝ) :=
  {selector | Measurable selector ∧ (∀omega,selector omega∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧

def actualWorstTailMean {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
    (loss : Ω→ℝ) (mass : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup ((fun selector=>actualTailMean P loss selector mass) '' admissibleSelectors P mass)

    Integrable selector P ∧ Integrable (fun omega=>loss omega*selector omega) P := by

  · apply (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).mono' hm.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hb omega).1]
    exact (hb omega).2
  · apply hi.mono (hi.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hm.aestronglyMeasurable)
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    change |loss omega*selector omega|≤|loss omega|
    simp only [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (hb omega).1]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) (hb omega).2

theorem actual_pointwise_hinge_bounds_every_fractional_selected_loss
    (value threshold selector : ℝ) (hs : selector∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    value*selector≤hinge value threshold+threshold*selector := by
  unfold hinge
  by_cases hv : threshold≤value
  · rw [max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hv)]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hv) (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2)]
  · rw [max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr (le_of_not_ge hv))]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_not_ge hv)) hs.1]

theorem actual_every_admissible_fractional_tail_is_bounded_by_every_RU_threshold
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω→ℝ) (hi : Integrable loss P) (alpha threshold : ℝ) (ha : alpha<1)
    (selector : Ω→ℝ) (hs : selector∈admissibleSelectors P (1-alpha)) :
    actualTailMean P loss selector (1-alpha)≤actualRUObjective P loss alpha threshold := by
  obtain ⟨hsm,hsb,hsmass⟩ := hs
  have hsi := actual_bounded_selectors_and_selected_losses_are_integrable loss selector hi hsm hsb
  have hh := actual_integrable_random_loss_has_integrable_hinge_at_every_threshold loss hi threshold
  have hb := integral_mono hsi.2 (hh.add (hsi.1.const_mul threshold))
    (fun omega=>actual_pointwise_hinge_bounds_every_fractional_selected_loss (loss omega) threshold (selector omega) (hsb omega))
  change (∫omega,loss omega*selector omega ∂P)≤
    (∫omega,hinge (loss omega) threshold+threshold*selector omega ∂P) at hb
  rw [integral_add hh (hsi.1.const_mul threshold),integral_const_mul,hsmass] at hb
  unfold actualTailMean actualRUObjective
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr ha)).mpr
  have he : (threshold+1/(1-alpha)*(∫omega,hinge (loss omega) threshold ∂P))*(1-alpha)=
      (∫omega,hinge (loss omega) threshold ∂P)+threshold*(1-alpha) := by
    field_simp [(sub_pos.mpr ha).ne']
    ring
  rw [he]
  exact hb

theorem actual_threshold_tail_selector_has_exact_hinge_identity
    (value threshold selector : ℝ) (_hs : selector∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (habove : threshold<value→selector=1) (hbelow : value<threshold→selector=0) :
    value*selector=hinge value threshold+threshold*selector := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy value threshold with h | h | h
  · rw [hbelow h]
    simp [hinge,max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr h.le)]
  · rw [h]
    simp [hinge]
  · rw [habove h]
    simp [hinge,max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr h.le)]

theorem actual_mass_matched_threshold_selector_attains_the_RU_value
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω→ℝ) (hi : Integrable loss P) (alpha threshold : ℝ) (ha : alpha<1)
    (selector : Ω→ℝ) (hs : selector∈admissibleSelectors P (1-alpha))
    (habove : ∀omega,threshold<loss omega→selector omega=1)
    (hbelow : ∀omega,loss omega<threshold→selector omega=0) :
    actualTailMean P loss selector (1-alpha)=actualRUObjective P loss alpha threshold := by
  obtain ⟨hsm,hsb,hsmass⟩ := hs
  have hsi := actual_bounded_selectors_and_selected_losses_are_integrable loss selector hi hsm hsb
  have hh := actual_integrable_random_loss_has_integrable_hinge_at_every_threshold loss hi threshold
  have he : (fun omega=>loss omega*selector omega)=
      (fun omega=>hinge (loss omega) threshold+threshold*selector omega) := by
    funext omega
    exact actual_threshold_tail_selector_has_exact_hinge_identity (loss omega) threshold (selector omega)
      (hsb omega) (habove omega) (hbelow omega)
  unfold actualTailMean
  rw [he,integral_add hh (hsi.1.const_mul threshold),integral_const_mul,hsmass]
  unfold actualRUObjective
  field_simp [(sub_pos.mpr ha).ne']
  ring

theorem actual_mass_matched_threshold_selector_is_greatest_tail_and_least_RU_objective
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω→ℝ) (hi : Integrable loss P) (alpha threshold : ℝ) (ha : alpha<1)
    (selector : Ω→ℝ) (hs : selector∈admissibleSelectors P (1-alpha))
    (habove : ∀omega,threshold<loss omega→selector omega=1)
    (hbelow : ∀omega,loss omega<threshold→selector omega=0) :
    IsGreatest ((fun other=>actualTailMean P loss other (1-alpha)) '' admissibleSelectors P (1-alpha))
      (actualTailMean P loss selector (1-alpha)) ∧
    IsLeast (Set.range (actualRUObjective P loss alpha)) (actualRUObjective P loss alpha threshold) ∧
    actualWorstTailMean P loss (1-alpha)=actualRUObjective P loss alpha threshold := by
  have he := actual_mass_matched_threshold_selector_attains_the_RU_value loss hi alpha threshold ha selector hs habove hbelow
  have hg : IsGreatest ((fun other=>actualTailMean P loss other (1-alpha)) '' admissibleSelectors P (1-alpha))
      (actualTailMean P loss selector (1-alpha)) := by
    refine ⟨⟨selector,hs,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    rintro value ⟨other,ho,rfl⟩
    rw [he]
    exact actual_every_admissible_fractional_tail_is_bounded_by_every_RU_threshold loss hi alpha threshold ha other ho
  refine ⟨hg,?_,?_⟩
  · refine ⟨⟨threshold,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    rintro value ⟨other,rfl⟩
    rw [←he]
    exact actual_every_admissible_fractional_tail_is_bounded_by_every_RU_threshold loss hi alpha other ha selector hs
  · exact hg.csSup_eq.trans he

def actualRUObjective {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
    (loss : Ω → ℝ) (alpha threshold : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  threshold + (1 / (1 - alpha)) * ∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) threshold ∂P

theorem actual_RU_one_sided_difference_quotients_follow_from_true_bounded_convergence
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω → ℝ) (hm : Measurable loss) (hi : Integrable loss P)
    (alpha center : ℝ) (_halpha0 : 0 ≤ alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1) :
    Tendsto (fun threshold =>
      (actualRUObjective P loss alpha threshold - actualRUObjective P loss alpha center) /
        (threshold - center)) (𝓝[>] center)
      (𝓝 (1 - P.real {omega | center < loss omega} / (1 - alpha))) ∧
    Tendsto (fun threshold =>
      (actualRUObjective P loss alpha threshold - actualRUObjective P loss alpha center) /
        (threshold - center)) (𝓝[<] center)
      (𝓝 (1 - P.real {omega | center ≤ loss omega} / (1 - alpha))) := by
  have hr := actual_bounded_convergence_moves_both_one_sided_hinge_quotients_through_expectation
    loss hm hi center
  have hg (threshold : ℝ) (hne : threshold ≠ center) :
      (actualRUObjective P loss alpha threshold - actualRUObjective P loss alpha center) /
        (threshold - center) = 1 + (1 / (1 - alpha)) *
          (((∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) threshold ∂P) -
            (∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) center ∂P)) / (threshold - center)) := by
    unfold actualRUObjective
    field_simp [sub_ne_zero.mpr hne, (sub_pos.mpr halpha1).ne']
    ring
  constructor
  · have ht := (hr.1.const_mul (1 / (1 - alpha))).const_add 1
    have heq : (1 : ℝ) + 1 / (1 - alpha) * (-P.real {omega | center < loss omega}) =
        1 - P.real {omega | center < loss omega} / (1 - alpha) := by ring
    rw [heq] at ht
    apply ht.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with threshold hn
    change center < threshold at hn
    exact (hg threshold hn.ne').symm
  · have ht := (hr.2.const_mul (1 / (1 - alpha))).const_add 1
    have heq : (1 : ℝ) + 1 / (1 - alpha) * (-P.real {omega | center ≤ loss omega}) =
        1 - P.real {omega | center ≤ loss omega} / (1 - alpha) := by ring
    rw [heq] at ht
    apply ht.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with threshold hn
    change threshold < center at hn
    exact (hg threshold hn.ne).symm

end SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsCVaRQuotients

import Mathlib

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Set MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped Topology
namespace SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsHingeExpectations

def hinge (value threshold : ℝ) : ℝ := max (value - threshold) 0
def hingeQuotient (value center threshold : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (hinge value threshold - hinge value center) / (threshold - center)

theorem actual_hinge_difference_quotients_are_uniformly_bounded_by_one
    (value center threshold : ℝ) : |hingeQuotient value center threshold| ≤ 1 := by
  have hb := abs_max_sub_max_le_max (value - threshold) 0 (value - center) 0
  have heq : (value - threshold) - (value - center) = -(threshold - center) := by ring
  simp only [sub_zero, abs_zero] at hb
  rw [heq, abs_neg, max_eq_left (abs_nonneg (threshold - center))] at hb
  change |hinge value threshold - hinge value center| ≤ |threshold - center| at hb
  unfold hingeQuotient
  rw [abs_div]
  by_cases he : threshold = center
  · simp [he]
  · exact (div_le_one (abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr he))).mpr hb

theorem actual_every_point_right_hinge_quotient_limit_retains_the_strict_tail
    (value center : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun threshold => hingeQuotient value center threshold) (𝓝[>] center)
      (𝓝 (if center < value then (-1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
  by_cases h : center < value
  · simp only [ite_eq_left h]
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    have hi0 : ∀ᶠ threshold in 𝓝 center, threshold < value := Iio_mem_nhds h
    have hi : ∀ᶠ threshold in 𝓝[>] center, threshold < value :=
      hi0.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    filter_upwards [hi, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with threshold ht hn
    change center < threshold at hn
    unfold hingeQuotient hinge
    rw [max_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_left (by linarith)]
    field_simp [(sub_pos.mpr hn).ne']
    ring
  · simp only [ite_eq_right h]
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with threshold hn
    change center < threshold at hn
    have hc : value ≤ center := le_of_not_gt h
    simp [hingeQuotient, hinge, max_eq_right (by linarith : value - threshold ≤ 0),
      max_eq_right (by linarith : value - center ≤ 0)]

theorem actual_every_point_left_hinge_quotient_limit_retains_the_nonstrict_tail
    (value center : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun threshold => hingeQuotient value center threshold) (𝓝[<] center)
      (𝓝 (if center ≤ value then (-1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
  by_cases h : center ≤ value
  · simp only [ite_eq_left h]
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with threshold hn
    change threshold < center at hn
    unfold hingeQuotient hinge
    rw [max_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_left (by linarith)]
    field_simp [sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_lt hn)]
    ring
  · simp only [ite_eq_right h]
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    have hv : value < center := lt_of_not_ge h
    have hi0 : ∀ᶠ threshold in 𝓝 center, value < threshold := Ioi_mem_nhds hv
    have hi : ∀ᶠ threshold in 𝓝[<] center, value < threshold :=
      hi0.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    filter_upwards [hi] with threshold ht
    simp [hingeQuotient, hinge, max_eq_right (by linarith : value - threshold ≤ 0),
      max_eq_right (by linarith : value - center ≤ 0)]

theorem actual_integrable_random_loss_has_integrable_hinge_at_every_threshold
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω → ℝ) (h : Integrable loss P) (threshold : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun omega => hinge (loss omega) threshold) P := by
  exact (h.sub (integrable_const threshold)).sup (integrable_const 0)

theorem actual_bounded_convergence_moves_both_one_sided_hinge_quotients_through_expectation
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (loss : Ω → ℝ) (hm : Measurable loss) (hi : Integrable loss P) (center : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun threshold =>
      ((∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) threshold ∂P) -
        (∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) center ∂P)) / (threshold - center))
      (𝓝[>] center) (𝓝 (-P.real {omega | center < loss omega})) ∧
    Tendsto (fun threshold =>
      ((∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) threshold ∂P) -
        (∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) center ∂P)) / (threshold - center))
      (𝓝[<] center) (𝓝 (-P.real {omega | center ≤ loss omega})) := by
  have hmeas (threshold : ℝ) :
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun omega => hingeQuotient (loss omega) center threshold) P := by
    unfold hingeQuotient hinge
    exact ((((hm.sub measurable_const).max measurable_const).sub
      ((hm.sub measurable_const).max measurable_const)).div_const _).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hbound (threshold : ℝ) : ∀ᵐ omega ∂P,
      ‖hingeQuotient (loss omega) center threshold‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ) :=
    Eventually.of_forall (fun omega => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        actual_hinge_difference_quotients_are_uniformly_bounded_by_one (loss omega) center threshold)
  have hright := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ))
    (Eventually.of_forall hmeas) (Eventually.of_forall hbound) (integrable_const 1)
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun omega =>
      actual_every_point_right_hinge_quotient_limit_retains_the_strict_tail (loss omega) center))
  have hleft := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ))
    (Eventually.of_forall hmeas) (Eventually.of_forall hbound) (integrable_const 1)
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun omega =>
      actual_every_point_left_hinge_quotient_limit_retains_the_nonstrict_tail (loss omega) center))
  have hformula (threshold : ℝ) :
      (∫ omega, hingeQuotient (loss omega) center threshold ∂P) =
      ((∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) threshold ∂P) -
        (∫ omega, hinge (loss omega) center ∂P)) / (threshold - center) := by
    unfold hingeQuotient
    rw [integral_div, integral_sub
      (actual_integrable_random_loss_has_integrable_hinge_at_every_threshold loss hi threshold)
      (actual_integrable_random_loss_has_integrable_hinge_at_every_threshold loss hi center)]
  have hrightIntegral :
      (∫ omega, (if center < loss omega then (-1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂P) =
        -P.real {omega | center < loss omega} := by
    have hs : MeasurableSet {omega | center < loss omega} := measurableSet_lt measurable_const hm
    calc
      _ = (∫ omega, ({omega | center < loss omega}).indicator
          (fun _ : Ω => (-1 : ℝ)) omega ∂P) := by rfl
      _ = _ := by simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_neg_one] using integral_indicator_const (-1 : ℝ) hs
  have hleftIntegral :
      (∫ omega, (if center ≤ loss omega then (-1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂P) =
        -P.real {omega | center ≤ loss omega} := by
    have hs : MeasurableSet {omega | center ≤ loss omega} := measurableSet_le measurable_const hm
    calc
      _ = (∫ omega, ({omega | center ≤ loss omega}).indicator
          (fun _ : Ω => (-1 : ℝ)) omega ∂P) := by rfl
      _ = _ := by simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_neg_one] using integral_indicator_const (-1 : ℝ) hs
  simpa only [hformula, hrightIntegral, hleftIntegral] using And.intro hright hleft

end SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsHingeExpectations

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesBook.thermal_disk_invariant

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesBook.thermal_energy_identity

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesBook.thermal_energy_strict

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesBook.thermal_starting_example

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesBook.thermal_step

theorem thermal_step (T u w : ℝ) (hT : T ∈ Icc 15 60)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesBook.trajectory_conformal_size

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCayley.actual_cayley_plus_identity_is_invertible

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCayley.actual_skew_cayley_denominator_is_invertible

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCayley.actual_skew_cayley_numerator_is_invertible

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCayley.actual_skew_cayley_numerator_is_transposed_denominator

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCayleyInverse.actual_inverse_cayley_right_denominator_identity

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCayleyInverse.actual_orthogonal_denominator_invertible_iff_no_negative_one_eigenvector

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCayleyInverse.actual_orthogonal_without_negative_one_has_unique_skew_preimage

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCayleyRange.actual_every_orthogonal_reflection_has_negative_one_eigenvector

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCayleyRange.actual_plane_cayley_range_is_exact

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_cholesky_existence_iff_positive_definite
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_cholesky_existence_iff_positive_definite
    (matrix : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    matrix.PosDef ↔ ∃ lower : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ,
      lower.IsLowerTriangular ∧ (∀ i, 0 < lower i i) ∧ matrix=lower*lowerᵀ

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_cholesky_factor_reuses_inverse
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_cholesky_factor_reuses_inverse
    (matrix lower : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hfactor : matrix=lower*lowerᵀ) :
    matrix⁻¹=(lower⁻¹)ᵀ*lower⁻¹

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_exact_cholesky_failure_iff_not_positive_definite

theorem actual_exact_cholesky_failure_iff_not_positive_definite
    (matrix : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (¬∃ lower : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ,
      lower.IsLowerTriangular ∧ (∀ i, 0 < lower i i) ∧ matrix=lower*lowerᵀ) ↔

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_gram_factor_diagonal_is_positive

theorem actual_gram_factor_diagonal_is_positive
    (hdim : finrank ℝ E=Fintype.card (Fin n)) (vectors : Fin n → E)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_gram_factor_is_lower_triangular

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_gram_factor_product

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_gram_schmidt_diagonal_is_norm

theorem actual_gram_schmidt_diagonal_is_norm (vectors : Fin n → E)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_positive_definite_leading_principal_minors_are_positive

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_positive_definite_matrix_has_cholesky
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_positive_definite_matrix_has_cholesky

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_positive_triangular_factor_implies_positive_definite

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesChords.actual_linear_activation_has_declared_slope

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesChords.scalar_qc_iff_realizable_actual_increment

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesChords.unit_interval_qc_is_scalar_product

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesClassificationCertificate.actual_class_pair_gap_has_euclidean_increment_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_class_pair_gap_has_euclidean_increment_bound
    {X : Type*} (weight : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ) (feature : X → I → ℝ)
    (firstClass secondClass : O) (first second : X) :
    |(actualClassLogits weight bias feature first firstClass-actualClassLogits weight bias feature first secondClass)-
      (actualClassLogits weight bias feature second firstClass-actualClassLogits weight bias feature second secondClass)| ≤
    actualClassPairGain weight firstClass secondClass*‖WithLp.toLp 2 (feature first-feature second)‖

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesClassificationCertificate.actual_class_pair_gap_increment_is_weighted_feature_increment
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_class_pair_gap_increment_is_weighted_feature_increment
    {X : Type*} (weight : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ) (feature : X → I → ℝ)
    (firstClass secondClass : O) (first second : X) :
    (actualClassLogits weight bias feature first firstClass-actualClassLogits weight bias feature first secondClass)-
      (actualClassLogits weight bias feature second firstClass-actualClassLogits weight bias feature second secondClass)=
    ∑ coordinate,(weight firstClass coordinate-weight secondClass coordinate)*
      (feature first coordinate-feature second coordinate)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesClassificationCertificate.actual_class_pair_margin_preserves_order_within_ratio_radius
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_class_pair_margin_preserves_order_within_ratio_radius
    {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (weight : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ) (feature : X → I → ℝ)
    (hfeature : ∀ first second,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (feature first-feature second)‖ ≤ dist first second)
    (firstClass secondClass : O) (first second : X) (pairGain : ℝ) (hgain : 0 < pairGain)
    (hbound : actualClassPairGain weight firstClass secondClass ≤ pairGain)
    (hradius : dist first second <
      (actualClassLogits weight bias feature first firstClass-actualClassLogits weight bias feature first secondClass)/pairGain) :
    actualClassLogits weight bias feature second secondClass < actualClassLogits weight bias feature second firstClass

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesClassificationCertificate.actual_one_vs_rest_radius_preserves_unique_prediction
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_one_vs_rest_radius_preserves_unique_prediction
    {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (weight : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ) (feature : X → I → ℝ)
    (hfeature : ∀ first second,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (feature first-feature second)‖ ≤ dist first second)
    (winner : O) (pairGain : O → ℝ) (first second : X)
    (hgain : ∀ other,other≠winner → 0 < pairGain other)
    (hbound : ∀ other,other≠winner → actualClassPairGain weight winner other ≤ pairGain other)
    (hradius : ∀ other,other≠winner → dist first second <
      (actualClassLogits weight bias feature first winner-actualClassLogits weight bias feature first other)/pairGain other) :
    ∀ other,other≠winner → actualClassLogits weight bias feature second other < actualClassLogits weight bias feature second winner

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesClassificationLevels.actual_larger_pixel_level_is_outside_both_normalized_strict_radius_criteria
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_larger_pixel_level_is_outside_both_normalized_strict_radius_criteria :

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesClassificationLevels.actual_unnormalized_global_certificate_covers_both_closed_perturbation_levels
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_unnormalized_global_certificate_covers_both_closed_perturbation_levels
    (weight : Matrix (Fin 3) I ℝ) (bias : Fin 3 → ℝ) (feature : X → I → ℝ)
    (hfeature : ∀ first second,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (feature first-feature second)‖ ≤ dist first second)
    (hweight : ‖weight‖ ≤ 1) (first second : X)
    (hlogits : actualClassLogits weight bias feature first=actualSourceLogits)
    (epsilon : ℝ) (hlevel : epsilon=(36/255:ℝ) ∨ epsilon=(72/255:ℝ))
    (hperturbation : dist first second ≤ epsilon) :

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDesignTruncation.actual_source_matrix_exponential_remainder_is_below_the_literal_rational_bound

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDeterminantTaylor.actual_determinant_exact_second_order_expansion
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_determinant_exact_second_order_expansion
    (direction : Matrix N N ℝ) (step : ℝ) :
    (1+step • direction).det=1+step*direction.trace+
      (actualDeterminantRemainder direction).eval step*step^2

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDeterminantTaylor.actual_determinant_perturbation_factorization
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_determinant_perturbation_factorization
    (matrix direction : Matrix N N ℝ) (hnonsingular : matrix.det ≠ 0) (step : ℝ) :
    (matrix+step • direction).det=matrix.det*(1+step • (matrix⁻¹*direction)).det

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDeterminantTaylor.actual_determinant_second_order_remainder_is_bigO
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_determinant_second_order_remainder_is_bigO (direction : Matrix N N ℝ) :

      (fun step : ℝ => step^2)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDeterminantTaylor.actual_general_determinant_second_order_expansion
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_general_determinant_second_order_expansion
    (matrix direction : Matrix N N ℝ) (hnonsingular : matrix.det ≠ 0) :
    (fun step : ℝ => (matrix+step • direction).det-matrix.det-
      step*(matrix.det*(matrix⁻¹*direction).trace)) =O[𝓝 0] (fun step : ℝ => step^2)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDiagonalQC.all_diagonal_qcs_iff_coordinate_qcs
declarations.statement:
theorem all_diagonal_qcs_iff_coordinate_qcs (alpha beta : ℝ) (input hidden : K → ℝ) :
    (∀ multiplier : K → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 ≤ multiplier k) →
      0 ≤ diagonalQC alpha beta multiplier input hidden) ↔
    ∀ k, 0 ≤ scalarQC alpha beta (input k) (hidden k)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDiagonalQC.all_diagonal_qcs_iff_independent_diagonal_slopes
declarations.statement:
theorem all_diagonal_qcs_iff_independent_diagonal_slopes
    (alpha beta : ℝ) (hab : alpha ≤ beta) (input hidden : K → ℝ) :
    (∀ multiplier : K → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 ≤ multiplier k) →
      0 ≤ diagonalQC alpha beta multiplier input hidden) ↔
    ∃ slope : K → ℝ, (∀ k, alpha ≤ slope k ∧ slope k ≤ beta) ∧
      hidden=Matrix.diagonal slope *ᵥ input

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDiagonalQC.diagonal_qc_from_actual_activations
declarations.statement:
theorem diagonal_qc_from_actual_activations (activation : K → ℝ → ℝ) (alpha beta : ℝ)
    (hactivation : ∀ k, slopeRestricted (activation k) alpha beta)
    (multiplier : K → ℝ) (hmultiplier : ∀ k, 0 ≤ multiplier k) (first second : K → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ diagonalQC alpha beta multiplier (first-second)
      (fun k => activation k (first k)-activation k (second k))

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDiagonalQC.diagonal_qc_is_actual_block_quadratic
declarations.statement:
theorem diagonal_qc_is_actual_block_quadratic (alpha beta : ℝ) (multiplier input hidden : K → ℝ) :
    quadratic (diagonalQCMatrix alpha beta multiplier) (Sum.elim input hidden)=
      diagonalQC alpha beta multiplier input hidden

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDiagonalQC.diagonal_qc_matrix_is_stated_block
declarations.statement:
theorem diagonal_qc_matrix_is_stated_block (alpha beta : ℝ) (multiplier : K → ℝ) :
    diagonalQCMatrix alpha beta multiplier=
      Matrix.fromBlocks ((-2*alpha*beta) • Matrix.diagonal multiplier)
        ((alpha+beta) • Matrix.diagonal multiplier)
        ((alpha+beta) • Matrix.diagonal multiplier)
        ((-2:ℝ) • Matrix.diagonal multiplier)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDiagonalQC.scalar_qc_factorization
declarations.statement:
theorem scalar_qc_factorization (alpha beta input hidden : ℝ) :
    scalarQC alpha beta input hidden=-2*(hidden-alpha*input)*(hidden-beta*input)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDiagonalQC.scalar_qc_iff_admissible_chord
declarations.statement:
theorem scalar_qc_iff_admissible_chord (alpha beta input hidden : ℝ) (hab : alpha ≤ beta) :
    0 ≤ scalarQC alpha beta input hidden ↔
      ∃ slope : ℝ, alpha ≤ slope ∧ slope ≤ beta ∧ hidden=slope*input

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDissipation.actual_storage_dissipation_with_square_summable_input_has_bounded_square_summable_output
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_storage_dissipation_with_square_summable_input_has_bounded_square_summable_output
    (storage input output : ℕ → ℝ) (gain : ℝ)
    (hstorage : ∀ time,0 ≤ storage time)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicCascade.actual_connected_dynamic_cascade_has_every_finite_weighted_energy_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_connected_dynamic_cascade_has_every_finite_weighted_energy_bound
    (channels states : ℕ → ℕ)
    (layer : ∀ stage,actualFiniteDynamicLayer (states stage) (channels stage) (channels (stage+1)))
    (weight : ∀ stage,Matrix (Fin (channels stage)) (Fin (channels stage)) ℝ)
    (hstorage : ∀ stage,(layer stage).P.PosSemidef)
    (hactivation : ∀ stage,slopeRestricted (layer stage).activation 0 1)
    (hmultiplier : ∀ stage coordinate,0 ≤ (layer stage).multiplier coordinate)
    (hcertificate : ∀ stage,(actualLayerCertificate (layer stage).A (layer stage).B
      (layer stage).C (layer stage).D (layer stage).P (weight stage) (weight (stage+1))
        (layer stage).multiplier).PosSemidef)
    (firstState secondState : ∀ stage,ℕ → Fin (states stage) → ℝ)
    (firstInput secondInput : ∀ stage,ℕ → Fin (channels stage) → ℝ)
    (hfirstState : ∀ stage time,firstState stage (time+1)=
      actualLayerNextState (layer stage).A (layer stage).B (firstState stage time) (firstInput stage time))
    (hsecondState : ∀ stage time,secondState stage (time+1)=
      actualLayerNextState (layer stage).A (layer stage).B (secondState stage time) (secondInput stage time))
    (hinitial : ∀ stage,firstState stage 0=secondState stage 0)
    (hfirstConnection : ∀ stage time,firstInput (stage+1) time=
      actualLayerHidden (layer stage).C (layer stage).D (layer stage).bias (layer stage).activation
        (firstState stage time) (firstInput stage time))
    (hsecondConnection : ∀ stage time,secondInput (stage+1) time=
      actualLayerHidden (layer stage).C (layer stage).D (layer stage).bias (layer stage).activation
        (secondState stage time) (secondInput stage time))
    (depth horizon : ℕ) :
    (∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,quadratic (weight depth) (firstInput depth time-secondInput depth time)) ≤
      ∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,quadratic (weight 0) (firstInput 0 time-secondInput 0 time)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicCascade.actual_dynamic_cascade_euclidean_output_bound_from_source_endpoint_weights
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_dynamic_cascade_euclidean_output_bound_from_source_endpoint_weights
    {I O : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype O] [DecidableEq I]
    (W : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ) (weight : Matrix I I ℝ)
    (hweight : (weight-Wᵀ*W).PosSemidef) (first second : ℕ → I → ℝ)
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] (sourceFirst sourceSecond : ℕ → J → ℝ)
    (gain : ℝ) (horizon : ℕ)
    (hcascade : (∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,quadratic weight (first time-second time)) ≤
      ∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,quadratic ((gain^2) • (1 : Matrix J J ℝ))
        (sourceFirst time-sourceSecond time)) :
    (∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,∑ coordinate,
      ((W *ᵥ first time+bias) coordinate-(W *ᵥ second time+bias) coordinate)^2) ≤
      gain^2*(∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,∑ coordinate,
        (sourceFirst time coordinate-sourceSecond time coordinate)^2)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicCascade.actual_linear_output_gram_dominance_bounds_weighted_energy
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_linear_output_gram_dominance_bounds_weighted_energy
    {I O : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype O]
    (W : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ) (weight : Matrix I I ℝ)
    (hweight : (weight-Wᵀ*W).PosSemidef) (first second : ℕ → I → ℝ) (horizon : ℕ) :
    (∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,∑ coordinate,
      ((W *ᵥ first time+bias) coordinate-(W *ᵥ second time+bias) coordinate)^2) ≤
      ∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,quadratic weight (first time-second time)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicLayer.actual_bilinear_matrix_pullback
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_bilinear_matrix_pullback (M : Matrix J K ℝ) (P : Matrix J J ℝ)
    (N : Matrix J S ℝ) (first : K → ℝ) (second : S → ℝ) :
    first ⬝ᵥ ((Mᵀ*P*N) *ᵥ second) =
      (M *ᵥ first) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ (N *ᵥ second))

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicLayer.actual_layer_certificate_quadratic_identity
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_layer_certificate_quadratic_identity (A : Matrix S S ℝ) (B : Matrix S I ℝ)
    (C : Matrix O S ℝ) (D : Matrix O I ℝ) (P : Matrix S S ℝ)
    (Xin : Matrix I I ℝ) (Xout : Matrix O O ℝ) (multiplier : O → ℝ)
    (state : S → ℝ) (input : I → ℝ) (hidden : O → ℝ) :
    quadratic (actualLayerCertificate A B C D P Xin Xout multiplier)
      (Sum.elim (Sum.elim state input) hidden)=
      quadratic P state-quadratic P (A *ᵥ state+B *ᵥ input)+
      quadratic Xin input-quadratic Xout hidden-
      ∑ coordinate, multiplier coordinate*
        (2*((C *ᵥ state+D *ᵥ input) coordinate)*(hidden coordinate)-2*(hidden coordinate)^2)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicLayer.actual_quadratic_state_increment_expansion
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_quadratic_state_increment_expansion (P : Matrix S S ℝ)
    (first second : S → ℝ) :
    quadratic P (first+second)=quadratic P first+quadratic P second+
      first ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ second)+second ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ first)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicLayerSoundness.actual_dynamic_layer_activation_increment_satisfies_qc
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_dynamic_layer_activation_increment_satisfies_qc
    (C : Matrix O S ℝ) (D : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ) (activation : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hactivation : slopeRestricted activation 0 1) (multiplier : O → ℝ)
    (hweight : ∀ coordinate,0 ≤ multiplier coordinate)
    (firstState secondState : S → ℝ) (firstInput secondInput : I → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ coordinate,multiplier coordinate*
      (2*((C *ᵥ (firstState-secondState)+D *ᵥ (firstInput-secondInput)) coordinate)*
        ((actualLayerHidden C D bias activation firstState firstInput-
          actualLayerHidden C D bias activation secondState secondInput) coordinate)-
        2*((actualLayerHidden C D bias activation firstState firstInput-
          actualLayerHidden C D bias activation secondState secondInput) coordinate)^2)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicLayerSoundness.actual_dynamic_layer_lmi_implies_storage_dissipation
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_dynamic_layer_lmi_implies_storage_dissipation
    (A : Matrix S S ℝ) (B : Matrix S I ℝ) (C : Matrix O S ℝ) (D : Matrix O I ℝ)
    (P : Matrix S S ℝ) (Xin : Matrix I I ℝ) (Xout : Matrix O O ℝ)
    (bias : O → ℝ) (activation : ℝ → ℝ) (hactivation : slopeRestricted activation 0 1)
    (multiplier : O → ℝ) (hweight : ∀ coordinate,0 ≤ multiplier coordinate)
    (hcertificate : (actualLayerCertificate A B C D P Xin Xout multiplier).PosSemidef)
    (firstState secondState : S → ℝ) (firstInput secondInput : I → ℝ) :
    quadratic P (actualLayerNextState A B firstState firstInput-
      actualLayerNextState A B secondState secondInput)-quadratic P (firstState-secondState) ≤
      quadratic Xin (firstInput-secondInput)-quadratic Xout
        (actualLayerHidden C D bias activation firstState firstInput-
          actualLayerHidden C D bias activation secondState secondInput)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicLayerSoundness.actual_dynamic_preactivation_difference_cancels_bias
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_dynamic_preactivation_difference_cancels_bias
    (C : Matrix O S ℝ) (D : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicLayerTrajectory.actual_euclidean_layer_lmi_bounds_every_zero_initial_trajectory_energy
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_euclidean_layer_lmi_bounds_every_zero_initial_trajectory_energy
    (A : Matrix S S ℝ) (B : Matrix S I ℝ) (C : Matrix O S ℝ) (D : Matrix O I ℝ)
    (P : Matrix S S ℝ) (hP : P.PosSemidef) (gain : ℝ)
    (bias : O → ℝ) (activation : ℝ → ℝ) (hactivation : slopeRestricted activation 0 1)
    (multiplier : O → ℝ) (hweight : ∀ coordinate,0 ≤ multiplier coordinate)

        actualLayerHidden C D bias activation (secondState time) (secondInput time) coordinate)^2) ≤
      gain^2*(∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,∑ coordinate,
        (firstInput time coordinate-secondInput time coordinate)^2)

declarations.statement:
theorem actual_layer_lmi_bounds_every_finite_trajectory_weighted_energy
    (A : Matrix S S ℝ) (B : Matrix S I ℝ) (C : Matrix O S ℝ) (D : Matrix O I ℝ)
    (P : Matrix S S ℝ) (hP : P.PosSemidef)
    (Xin : Matrix I I ℝ) (Xout : Matrix O O ℝ)
    (bias : O → ℝ) (activation : ℝ → ℝ) (hactivation : slopeRestricted activation 0 1)

    (hfirst : ∀ time,firstState (time+1)=actualLayerNextState A B (firstState time) (firstInput time))
    (hsecond : ∀ time,secondState (time+1)=actualLayerNextState A B (secondState time) (secondInput time))

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicLayerTrajectory.actual_layer_lmi_bounds_zero_initial_trajectory_weighted_energy
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_layer_lmi_bounds_zero_initial_trajectory_weighted_energy
    (A : Matrix S S ℝ) (B : Matrix S I ℝ) (C : Matrix O S ℝ) (D : Matrix O I ℝ)
    (P : Matrix S S ℝ) (hP : P.PosSemidef)
    (Xin : Matrix I I ℝ) (Xout : Matrix O O ℝ)
    (bias : O → ℝ) (activation : ℝ → ℝ) (hactivation : slopeRestricted activation 0 1)
    (multiplier : O → ℝ) (hweight : ∀ coordinate,0 ≤ multiplier coordinate)
    (hcertificate : (actualLayerCertificate A B C D P Xin Xout multiplier).PosSemidef)
    (firstState secondState : ℕ → S → ℝ) (firstInput secondInput : ℕ → I → ℝ)
    (hfirst : ∀ time,firstState (time+1)=actualLayerNextState A B (firstState time) (firstInput time))
    (hsecond : ∀ time,secondState (time+1)=actualLayerNextState A B (secondState time) (secondInput time))
    (hinitial : firstState 0=secondState 0) (horizon : ℕ) :
    ∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,quadratic Xout
      (actualLayerHidden C D bias activation (firstState time) (firstInput time)-
        actualLayerHidden C D bias activation (secondState time) (secondInput time)) ≤
      ∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,quadratic Xin (firstInput time-secondInput time)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicNetwork.actual_connected_dynamic_network_lmis_imply_euclidean_gain
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_connected_dynamic_network_lmis_imply_euclidean_gain
    (channels states : ℕ → ℕ)
    (layer : ∀ stage,actualFiniteDynamicLayer (states stage) (channels stage) (channels (stage+1)))
    (weight : ∀ stage,Matrix (Fin (channels stage)) (Fin (channels stage)) ℝ)
    (hstorage : ∀ stage,(layer stage).P.PosSemidef)
    (hactivation : ∀ stage,slopeRestricted (layer stage).activation 0 1)
    (hmultiplier : ∀ stage coordinate,0 ≤ (layer stage).multiplier coordinate)
    (hcertificate : ∀ stage,(actualLayerCertificate (layer stage).A (layer stage).B
      (layer stage).C (layer stage).D (layer stage).P (weight stage) (weight (stage+1))
        (layer stage).multiplier).PosSemidef)
    (firstState secondState : ∀ stage,ℕ → Fin (states stage) → ℝ)
    (firstInput secondInput : ∀ stage,ℕ → Fin (channels stage) → ℝ)
    (hfirstState : ∀ stage time,firstState stage (time+1)=
      actualLayerNextState (layer stage).A (layer stage).B (firstState stage time) (firstInput stage time))
    (hsecondState : ∀ stage time,secondState stage (time+1)=
      actualLayerNextState (layer stage).A (layer stage).B (secondState stage time) (secondInput stage time))
    (hinitial : ∀ stage,firstState stage 0=secondState stage 0)
    (hfirstConnection : ∀ stage time,firstInput (stage+1) time=
      actualLayerHidden (layer stage).C (layer stage).D (layer stage).bias (layer stage).activation
        (firstState stage time) (firstInput stage time))
    (hsecondConnection : ∀ stage time,secondInput (stage+1) time=
      actualLayerHidden (layer stage).C (layer stage).D (layer stage).bias (layer stage).activation
        (secondState stage time) (secondInput stage time))
    (depth horizon outputDimension : ℕ)
    (W : Matrix (Fin outputDimension) (Fin (channels depth)) ℝ) (bias : Fin outputDimension → ℝ)
    (gain : ℝ) (hinputWeight : weight 0=(gain^2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin (channels 0)) (Fin (channels 0)) ℝ))
    (houtputWeight : (weight depth-Wᵀ*W).PosSemidef) :
    (∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,∑ coordinate,
      ((W *ᵥ firstInput depth time+bias) coordinate-(W *ᵥ secondInput depth time+bias) coordinate)^2) ≤
      gain^2*(∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,∑ coordinate,
        (firstInput 0 time coordinate-secondInput 0 time coordinate)^2)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidRoot.actual_ellipsoid_certificate_iff_true_normalized_eigenvalue_bound

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidRoot.actual_ellipsoid_certificate_is_equivalent_to_the_normalized_spectral_shift

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidRoot.actual_inverse_positive_square_root_congruence_normalizes_the_energy

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidRoot.actual_inverse_positive_square_root_exists_squares_and_is_invertible
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_inverse_positive_square_root_exists_squares_and_is_invertible

      (actualInversePositiveSquareRoot storage)ᵀ=actualInversePositiveSquareRoot storage ∧

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidRow.actual_inverse_metric_row_quadratic_and_pairing
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_inverse_metric_row_quadratic_and_pairing
    (storage : Matrix n n ℝ) (hs : storage.PosDef) (row vector : n → ℝ) :
    (storage⁻¹ *ᵥ row) ⬝ᵥ (storage *ᵥ (storage⁻¹ *ᵥ row)) = actualRowEnergy storage row ∧
    (storage⁻¹ *ᵥ row) ⬝ᵥ (storage *ᵥ vector) = row ⬝ᵥ vector

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidRow.actual_inverse_metric_vector_cancels_positive_storage

theorem actual_inverse_metric_vector_cancels_positive_storage

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidRow.actual_nonzero_row_attainer_has_energy_one_and_attains_the_support
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_nonzero_row_attainer_has_energy_one_and_attains_the_support
    (storage : Matrix n n ℝ) (hs : storage.PosDef) (row : n → ℝ) (hr : row ≠ 0) :
    actualRowAttainer storage row ⬝ᵥ (storage *ᵥ actualRowAttainer storage row) = 1 ∧

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidRow.actual_nonzero_row_has_positive_inverse_metric_energy

theorem actual_positive_metric_cauchy_schwarz_bounds_every_row
    (storage : Matrix n n ℝ) (hs : storage.PosDef) (row vector : n → ℝ) :

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidRow.actual_positive_storage_row_energy_is_nonnegative

theorem actual_positive_storage_row_energy_is_nonnegative

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidRow.actual_row_containment_schur_matrix_has_the_literal_inverse_metric_remainder
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_row_containment_schur_matrix_has_the_literal_inverse_metric_remainder

    (actualRadiusSquareMatrix radius) - actualRowMatrix row * storage⁻¹ * (actualRowMatrix row).transpose =

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidRow.actual_row_interval_containment_iff_the_exact_inverse_metric_bound

theorem actual_row_interval_containment_iff_the_exact_inverse_metric_bound

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidSProcedure.actual_ellipsoid_inhomogeneous_s_lemma_equivalence
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_ellipsoid_inhomogeneous_s_lemma_equivalence [Nonempty Index]
    (storage matrix : Matrix Index Index ℝ) (hstorage : storage.PosDef)
    (hmatrix : matrix.IsHermitian) (bound : ℝ) :
    (∀ vector : Index → ℝ,quadraticValue storage vector ≤ 1 → quadraticValue matrix vector ≤ bound) ↔
      ∃ multiplier : ℝ,0 ≤ multiplier ∧

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidSProcedure.actual_s_procedure_residual_is_globally_nonnegative_iff_literal_matrix_conditions
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_s_procedure_residual_is_globally_nonnegative_iff_literal_matrix_conditions

    (∀ vector : Index → ℝ,0 ≤ actualSProcedureResidual storage matrix bound multiplier vector) ↔

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidSProcedure.actual_s_procedure_residual_is_the_literal_constant_plus_quadratic
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_s_procedure_residual_is_the_literal_constant_plus_quadratic

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidSpectral.actual_true_largest_eigenvector_has_unit_energy_and_its_eigenvalue

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEpigraph.actual_source_epigraph_boundary_kernel
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_source_epigraph_boundary_kernel (first second : ℝ) :
    actualSourceEpigraphMatrix (first^2+second^2) first second*ᵥ![1,-first,-second]=0 ∧
      (actualSourceEpigraphMatrix (first^2+second^2) first second).det=0

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEpigraph.actual_source_epigraph_matrix_is_affine_in_unknowns
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_source_epigraph_matrix_is_affine_in_unknowns
    (bound first second otherBound otherFirst otherSecond left right : ℝ) (hsum : left+right=1) :
    actualSourceEpigraphMatrix (left*bound+right*otherBound) (left*first+right*otherFirst)
      (left*second+right*otherSecond)=
        left • actualSourceEpigraphMatrix bound first second+
          right • actualSourceEpigraphMatrix otherBound otherFirst otherSecond

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEpigraph.actual_source_epigraph_matrix_positive_definite_iff
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_source_epigraph_matrix_positive_definite_iff (bound first second : ℝ) :

theorem actual_source_epigraph_matrix_positive_semidefinite_iff (bound first second : ℝ) :

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEpigraph.actual_source_epigraph_quadratic_completion
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_source_epigraph_quadratic_completion (bound first second : ℝ) (input : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    input ⬝ᵥ(actualSourceEpigraphMatrix bound first second*ᵥinput)=
      (bound-first^2-second^2)*(input 0)^2+(input 1+first*input 0)^2+
        (input 2+second*input 0)^2

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEpigraph.actual_source_schur_boundary_rank_one_and_kernel
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_source_schur_boundary_rank_one_and_kernel :

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEpigraph.actual_source_schur_matrix_positive_definite_iff
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_source_schur_matrix_positive_definite_iff (bound : ℝ) :

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEpigraph.actual_source_schur_matrix_positive_semidefinite_iff
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_source_schur_matrix_positive_semidefinite_iff (bound : ℝ) :

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEpigraph.actual_source_schur_quadratic_completion
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_source_schur_quadratic_completion (bound : ℝ) (input : Fin 2 → ℝ) :

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEpigraph.actual_source_three_four_epigraph_least_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_source_three_four_epigraph_least_bound :
    (∀ bound : ℝ,(actualSourceEpigraphMatrix bound 3 4).PosSemidef ↔ 25≤bound) ∧
    (∀ bound : ℝ,(actualSourceEpigraphMatrix bound 3 4).PosDef ↔ 25<bound) ∧
    (actualSourceEpigraphMatrix 25 3 4).PosSemidef ∧
    (actualSourceEpigraphMatrix 25 3 4).det=0

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRBase.actual_fir_controllability_gramian_formula
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_fir_controllability_gramian_formula (gain freeParameter regularizer : ℝ) :
    actualFIRGramian gain freeParameter regularizer=
      ((1/gain^2+freeParameter^2+regularizer):ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRBase.actual_fir_dissipation_matrix_is_positive_definite

theorem actual_fir_dissipation_matrix_is_positive_definite

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRBase.actual_fir_dissipation_matrix_is_source_diagonal
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_fir_dissipation_matrix_is_source_diagonal (gain storage : ℝ) :

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRBase.actual_fir_inverse_gramian_storage_formula

theorem actual_fir_inverse_gramian_storage_formula

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRBase.actual_fir_source_unit_parameters
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_fir_source_unit_parameters :

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRBase.actual_fir_state_matrix_is_nilpotent_of_index_one

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRBase.actual_fir_state_space_realization
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_fir_state_space_realization (currentGain delayedGain : ℝ) (input : ℕ → ℝ) :
    actualFIRMemory input 0=0 ∧
    (∀ time,actualFIRMemory input (time+1)=0*actualFIRMemory input time+1*input time) ∧
    actualFIRResponse currentGain delayedGain input 0=currentGain*input 0 ∧
    (∀ time,actualFIRResponse currentGain delayedGain input (time+1)=
      delayedGain*input time+currentGain*input (time+1))

theorem actual_fir_storage_strictly_between_zero_and_gain_squared

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRBoundaryTightness.actual_defined_tangent_parameterized_gain_tight_iff
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_defined_tangent_parameterized_gain_tight_iff
    (gain storage angle : ℝ) (hgain : 0 ≤ gain) (hstorage : 0 < storage)
    (hupper : storage ≤ gain^2) (hcos : Real.cos angle≠0) :
    |actualParameterizedCurrentKernel gain storage angle|+|actualParameterizedDelayedKernel storage angle|=gain ↔
      Real.tan angle^2=(gain^2-storage)/storage

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRBoundaryTightness.actual_endpoint_parameterized_gain_tight_iff_sine_zero

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRBoundaryTightness.actual_nonnegative_regularizer_storage_is_positive_and_at_most_gain_squared

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRCorollaries.actual_positive_regularizer_or_nonzero_free_parameter_gives_interior_storage

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRCorollaries.actual_source_radical_filter_has_actual_infinite_energy_bound

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRCorollaries.actual_source_radical_kernels_are_actual_parameterized_kernels

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIRGain.actual_fir_frequency_bound

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIROperator.actual_fir_certificate_has_literal_dissipation_quadratic
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_fir_certificate_has_literal_dissipation_quadratic

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIROperator.actual_unit_row_cholesky_certificate_identity

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIROperator.actual_unit_row_cholesky_certificate_is_positive_semidefinite

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFIROperator.actual_zero_initial_fir_finite_horizon_energy_bound
